title: ollama
summary: Ollama simplifies running large language models (LLMs) locally on personal hardware. It provides a user-friendly desktop application and a robust backend for downloading, managing, and interacting with various LLMs. Users can chat with models, perform multimodal tasks like image generation, and developers can integrate its capabilities via a powerful API.

nodes.label: User / Developer
nodes.title: Ollama User / Developer
nodes.description: Interacts with Ollama via its desktop application, command-line interface, or integrates it into other applications via API.

nodes.label: Desktop UI
nodes.title: Ollama Desktop User Interface
nodes.description: Provides a graphical interface for managing models, chatting with LLMs, and configuring application settings.

nodes.label: Native App Host
nodes.title: Webview Host Integration
nodes.description: Integrates the web-based user interface with the native desktop application, enabling communication and control between the web content and the operating system.

nodes.label: LLM Inference Engine
nodes.title: Core LLM Inference Runtime
nodes.description: Manages the loading, context, text processing, and token sampling for Large Language Models, providing the core inference capabilities.

nodes.label: External Model Registry
nodes.title: Ollama Model Registry
nodes.description: A remote service or repository where Ollama models are hosted and can be downloaded from.

nodes.label: ML Hardware Backend
nodes.title: GGML Machine Learning Backend
nodes.description: Provides efficient, low-level machine learning operations, managing hardware backends (CPU, GPU), tensor computations, and model quantization.

nodes.label: Image Generation
nodes.title: Image Generation Module
nodes.description: Orchestrates the process of generating images from various inputs, leveraging machine learning models and frameworks like MLX for creative tasks.

nodes.label: System Hardware
nodes.title: Underlying System Hardware
nodes.description: The physical computing resources (CPU, GPU, RAM, storage) that Ollama utilizes for running models and the application.

groups.label: Application Frontend
groups.title: User Interaction & Desktop Integration
groups.description: This group encompasses all components responsible for user interaction, including the graphical user interface and its integration with the native desktop environment.

groups.label: LLM Core Services
groups.title: LLM Loading, Inference & Data
groups.description: This group manages the core functionalities for Large Language Models, including model loading, context management, text processing, and interaction with external model registries.

groups.label: Hardware & ML Operations
groups.title: Hardware Acceleration & ML Backend
groups.description: This group provides the low-level machine learning computations, hardware abstraction, and specialized capabilities like image generation, leveraging system resources.
